name: Chubb

logo.source: chubb.com home page header logo (chubb-logo-black.png, 550 px wide); the Wikipedia infobox file Chubb-Limited-logo.svg carries an editor note that it is not the version on the company homepage

description: Chubb is the world's largest publicly traded property and casualty insurer, selling commercial insurance to companies (from multinationals to small businesses), personal insurance to affluent and high-net-worth households, crop insurance, accident and health cover, reinsurance, and life insurance mainly in Asia. Most business arrives through insurance brokers and agents who are paid a commission. It earns premiums and then invests the float, so profit is underwriting income (premiums less claims and costs) plus investment income; a combined ratio below 100 percent means underwriting profit (85.7 percent for P&C in 2025). Catastrophe losses (for example wildfire and hurricanes) are the main swing factor.

employees.note: Approximately 45,000 people: 40 percent Asia, 37 percent North America, 13 percent Latin America, 10 percent Europe/Eurasia/Africa.

businessLines.name: North America Commercial P&C Insurance
businessLines.how: Sells commercial property, casualty, workers compensation, specialty and package cover to companies, mostly through brokers, for an annual premium; profit is premium less claims and expenses plus investment income on the float. 2025 P&C combined ratio 81.4 percent.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

businessLines.name: North America Personal P&C Insurance
businessLines.how: Sells homeowners, high-value home and auto, valuables and related cover to affluent individuals, through independent agents and brokers, with annual renewing premiums; results swing with catastrophe losses (2025 segment income fell 27 percent; combined ratio 91.5 percent).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

businessLines.name: North America Agricultural Insurance
businessLines.how: Crop insurance (Rain and Hail and ACI) sold through agents to farmers under federal crop programmes, plus farm and ranch property and casualty; premiums follow crop prices and acres; combined ratio 82.3 percent.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

businessLines.name: Overseas General Insurance
businessLines.how: Sells commercial and consumer property, casualty, accident and health and personal lines outside North America through brokers, agents and banks, plus Chubb Global Markets in London and Huatai P&C in China; annual premiums, many in local currency. Combined ratio 85.0 percent.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

businessLines.name: Global Reinsurance
businessLines.how: Sells reinsurance (Chubb Tempest Re and Chubb Re) to other insurers, who pay premiums to lay off their own catastrophe and casualty risk; profit swings with large loss events; combined ratio 79.3 percent.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

businessLines.name: Life Insurance
businessLines.how: Sells life, accident and health, personal accident and savings products mainly in Asia and Latin America through agents, banks and direct marketing, plus Chubb Benefits employer cover in the US; premiums are recurring and build a long-tail policy book.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net premiums written, segment income (underwriting income plus net investment income and other, before corporate)

brands.name: Huatai P&C (China, consolidated; sits in Overseas General)
brands.note: China-based property and casualty insurer consolidated by Chubb; revenue not broken out in the pages read.

brands.name: Chubb Global Markets (London specialty)
brands.note: in Overseas General; premiums not broken out in the pages read

brands.name: Chubb Life
brands.note: Life Insurance segment, $7,279M net premiums written (13.3 percent of total)

whatsNext.text: Completed acquisition of Liberty Mutual's property and casualty insurance business in Thailand (adds to Asia growth in Q2 2026)
